**Methodological description (English):** Being approached by unknown people or separated from familiar companions calls for independent judgement about safe distance, exit options and trustworthy assistance, without assuming every unfamiliar person is dangerous.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qoğamdyq jerde jaisyz jaqyndasuğa ne serıkterden adasuğa qalai äreket etu keregın üiren.

##### Qoğamdyq jerde qauıptı jaqyndasuğa äreket etu

[respondToUnsafeApproachesInPublic.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/personalSafetyInPublicPlaces/respondToUnsafeApproachesInPublic.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize unwanted invitations, requests for secrecy, pressure to leave a safe location or other suspicious approaches; maintain distance, decline unsafe requests and seek support from an appropriate trusted person or service.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıptı şaqyrulardy tanyp, tiıstı kömek sūra.

##### Adasqanda nemese bölınıp qalğanda kömek sūrau

[seekHelpWhenLostOrSeparated.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/personalSafetyInPublicPlaces/seekHelpWhenLostOrSeparated.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use an appropriate safe location, identifiable helpers and reliable contact channels when separated from companions; avoid sharing unnecessary personal information or following an unverified stranger.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adassañ, qauıpsız oryn men senımdı kömekşılerdı tap.

#### Qūraldar jäne jūmys oryndary

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Protective procedures depend on the activity, equipment, and conditions; professional work requires role-appropriate training.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūraldar men jabdyqtardy qoldanğanda qorğanys şaralaryn oryndaudy üiren.

##### Jabdyqpen qauıpsız jūmys tärtıbın saqtau

[followSafeEquipmentProcedures.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/followSafeEquipmentProcedures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respect guards, operating limits, maintenance restrictions, and stop conditions without attempting unauthorized repair.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qorğanys qaptamalary, toqtatu şarttary jäne oqytu talaptaryn saqta.

##### Qauıpsızdık belgılerı men nūsqaulardy oqu

[readSafetySignsAndInstructions.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/readSafetySignsAndInstructions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret warning symbols, restricted areas, and equipment guidance in context instead of treating a label as complete protection.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jūmys ornyndağy eskertuler men qauıpsızdık belgılerınıñ şekteuın tüsın.

##### Jeke qorğanys qūraldaryn paidalanu

[usePersonalProtectiveEquipment.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/everydayAndOccupationalSafety/toolsAndWorkplaces/usePersonalProtectiveEquipment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match protection to the hazard and fit, recognizing that protective equipment does not eliminate the hazard.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Naqty qauıpke sai qorğanys jabdyğyn tañda.

### Alğaşqy kömek jäne şūğyl äreket

Groups: 5 · Skills: 25

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Immediate assistance aims to recognize danger, activate professional help, and provide appropriate basic interventions within training and scene safety. Clinical treatment and invasive procedures are not implied by inclusion in the taxonomy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şūğyl qauıptı tanudy, kömek şaqyrudy jäne tiıstı bastapqy järdem körsetudı üiren.

#### Negızgı tırşılık qoldauy

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Resuscitation competencies require validated techniques and updated guidance appropriate to the person's age, circumstances, and responder training.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qazırgı daiarlyqqa sai negızgı tırşılık qoldauynyñ tanylğan ädısterımen tanys.

##### Avtomatty syrtqy defibrilliatordy paidalanu

[automatedExternalDefibrillatorUse.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/automatedExternalDefibrillatorUse.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize an AED, follow its prompts, and coordinate its use with resuscitation while maintaining scene safety.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Reanimatsiia kezınde AED nūsqaularyn qalai oryndau keregın tüsın.

##### Jürek-ökpe reanimatsiiasy

[cardiopulmonaryResuscitation.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/cardiopulmonaryResuscitation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize when CPR is indicated and apply current age-appropriate basic life support principles within the responder's training.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Keude quysyna qysym jasau men basqa JÖR şaralary qaşan qajet boluy mümkın ekenın tany.

[firstAidForChoking.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/basicLifeSupport/firstAidForChoking.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish effective coughing from severe airway obstruction and follow appropriate age-specific first-aid guidance rather than improvising.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tynys joly bıteluınıñ şūğyl jağdaiyn jäne jasqa sai ärekettı tany.

#### Qan ketu jäne jaraqattar

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** First aid aims to prevent immediate deterioration while avoiding unnecessary manipulation or delay in definitive medical care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Meditsinalyq kömek kelgenşe jaraqat pen syrtqy qan ketudıñ saldaryn azaitudy üiren.

##### Kışıgırım jaralardy kütu

[careForMinorWounds.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/careForMinorWounds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce contamination, control minor bleeding, and recognize wounds requiring professional evaluation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūsaq jaralardy tazalap, qorğa jäne qaşan därıger qarauy qajet ekenın tany.

##### Syrtqy qan ketudı toqtatu

[controlExternalBleeding.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/controlExternalBleeding.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Apply appropriate direct pressure and escalation when bleeding is severe, while protecting the responder from body-fluid exposure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özıñdı qorğai otyryp qan ketudı toqtatu üşın tiıstı qysym jasa.

##### Küdıktı synyqty qimylsyzdandyru

[immobilizeSuspectedFractures.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/immobilizeSuspectedFractures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limit movement and provide appropriate support without attempting to straighten a suspected fracture or dislocation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Synğan boluy mümkın süiektı tıre, özıñ tüzetuge tyryspa.

##### Bas pen omyrtqa jaraqatynyñ qaupın tanu

[recognizeHeadAndSpinalInjuryDanger.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/recognizeHeadAndSpinalInjuryDanger.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify concerning mechanisms or symptoms and avoid unnecessary movement while arranging urgent evaluation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bas nemese omyrtqa jaraqatyna küdık bolsa nelıkten saq äreket etu keregın tüsın.

[useATourniquetWhenIndicated.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/bleedingAndInjuries/useATourniquetWhenIndicated.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize life-threatening limb bleeding and the need for a correctly applied tourniquet according to current training and guidance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aiaq-qoldan qatty qan ketkende daiyndalğan adamnyñ turniket qoiuy qaşan qajet ekenın tüsın.

#### Qorşağan orta jäne jedel jaraqattar

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Temperature, substances, and water exposure can rapidly worsen an individual's condition and demand hazard-specific first aid.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küiık, ziiandy äser, temperaturalyq tötenşe jağdailar jäne suğa batu kezındegı qauıpsız äreketterdı üiren.

##### Himiialyq zat äserınen alğaşqy kömek

[firstAidForChemicalExposure.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/firstAidForChemicalExposure.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize rescuer protection, interruption of exposure when safe and appropriate professional or poison-service instructions for skin, eye or inhalation contact; avoid improvised neutralization or hazardous handling.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıptı himiialyq äserden keiın özıñdı qorğap, naqty nūsqaulyq sūra.

##### Termiialyq küiıkte alğaşqy kömek

[firstAidForThermalBurns.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/firstAidForThermalBurns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** End thermal exposure when safe, cool a heat burn appropriately and recognize features that require urgent medical assessment; chemical injuries require different hazard-specific precautions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Alğaşqy salqyndatudy jäne küiık kezınde qaşan şūğyl meditsinalyq kömek keregın tüsın.

##### Suğa batqannan keiın alğaşqy kömek

[provideFirstAidAfterDrowning.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/provideFirstAidAfterDrowning.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the special urgency of impaired breathing after submersion, arrange emergency response and apply appropriate current resuscitation and monitoring guidance within training; do not delay vital assistance for nonessential actions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Suğa batudan keiıngı şūğyl tynys alu qaupın jäne jedel kömektıñ qajettıgın tany.

##### Ystyqtan bolğan auruğa äreket etu

[respondToHeatIllness.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/respondToHeatIllness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish concerning heat-related symptoms and prioritize safe cooling and escalation for severe illness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qatty ystyqtan tuyndağan auyr küidı jäne salqyndatu men jedel kömektıñ qajettıgın tany.

##### Gipotermiiağa äreket etu

[respondToHypothermia.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/environmentalAndAcuteInjuries/respondToHypothermia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Limit further cooling, handle an affected person carefully, and recognize that severe cold exposure needs urgent assessment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Odan ärı jylu joğaltudy azait jäne qauıptı suyq äserınen keiın meditsinalyq bağalau sūra.

#### Bastapqy bağalau jäne kömek

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Initial response begins with rescuer safety, recognition of urgent changes in responsiveness or breathing, and continued observation. Calling for help uses the shared competency in Emergencies and Civil Protection rather than a duplicate Skill.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jedel kömek qajet boluy mümkın adamnyñ jağdaiyn bağalaudyñ alğaşqy qadamdaryn üiren.

##### Tynys aludy bağalau

[assessBreathing.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/assessBreathing.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize absent or abnormal breathing as a medical emergency without delaying the call for help.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şūğyl ärekettı qajet etetın qalyptan tys tynysty ne tynystyñ bolmauyn tany.

##### Jauap beru qabıletın bağalau

[assessResponsiveness.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/assessResponsiveness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Check whether a person responds and recognize when reduced responsiveness requires immediate escalation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamnyñ qalypty jauap bermeuın tany.

##### Kömekteser aldynda oqiğa ornynyñ qauıpsızdıgın bağalau

[assessSceneSafetyBeforeHelping.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/assessSceneSafetyBeforeHelping.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify traffic, fire, electricity, violence, contamination, or unstable surroundings before approaching an affected person.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaralanğan adamğa jaqyndau özıñe qauıp töndırmeitının tekser.

[careForAnUnresponsivePersonWhoIsBreathingNormally.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/initialAssessmentAndHelp/careForAnUnresponsivePersonWhoIsBreathingNormally.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Provide appropriate positioning and continuous monitoring while arranging urgent help for an unresponsive person who breathes normally; account for possible trauma and avoid unnecessary movement.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jauap bermeitın, bıraq tynys alatyn adamğa kömektesıp, kömek kelgenşe baqyla.

#### Şūğyl meditsinalyq jağdailar

Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prompt recognition and appropriate escalation are more important than attempting diagnosis or administering unfamiliar medication.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jedel meditsinalyq kömektı qajet etetın qauıptı belgılerdı tanudy üiren.

##### Jürek talmasynyñ belgılerın tanu

[recognizeSignsOfAHeartAttack.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/recognizeSignsOfAHeartAttack.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify concerning chest discomfort and associated symptoms as possible medical emergencies requiring timely assistance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jürek talmasyn körsetuı mümkın belgılerdı tany.

##### İnsult belgılerın tanu

[recognizeSignsOfStroke.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/recognizeSignsOfStroke.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use sudden neurological changes as reasons for urgent emergency response, even if symptoms appear to improve.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnsulttı bıldıruı mümkın kenet paida bolğan belgılerdı tany.

##### Qūrysu ūstamasyna äreket etu

[respondToSeizures.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSeizures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Protect the person from surrounding injury, avoid harmful restraint, and recognize conditions requiring urgent assistance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūstama kezınde adamnyñ ainalasyn qauıpsız etıp, jaraqat aludan qorğa, bıraq qimylyn küşpen tejeme.

##### Auyr allergiialyq reaktsiiağa äreket etu

[respondToSevereAllergicReaction.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSevereAllergicReaction.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize possible anaphylaxis and the need for rapid emergency help and appropriate trained use of prescribed rescue medication.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Auyr allergiialyq reaktsiiany jyldam kömek qajet etetın şūğyl jağdai dep tany.

##### Tynys aludyñ auyr qiyndauyna äreket etu

[respondToSevereBreathingDifficulty.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSevereBreathingDifficulty.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize major difficulty breathing, severe respiratory distress or rapidly worsening symptoms as reasons to activate emergency assistance and support a safe position while awaiting qualified care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tynys alu qatty qiyndasa ne naşarlasa şūğyl kömek sūra.

##### Gipoglikemiiağa küdık tuyndağanda äreket etu

[respondToSuspectedHypoglycaemia.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSuspectedHypoglycaemia.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize possible low blood glucose and distinguish safe assistance for a person who is fully alert and can swallow from the need for urgent help when consciousness or swallowing is impaired.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qandağy qanttyñ tüsuın tany jäne jūtu qauıpsız bolmasa auyz arqyly eşteñe bermeu keregın tüsın.

##### Opioidtyñ artyq dozalanuyna küdık tuğandağy äreket

[respondToSuspectedOpioidOverdose.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSuspectedOpioidOverdose.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize dangerous respiratory depression or unresponsiveness following possible opioid exposure, activate emergency services and understand the role of naloxone and basic life support where available and within training.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Opioidtyñ artyq dozalanuy mümkın ekenın tanyp, jedel kömek pen nalokson qajettıgın tüsın.

##### Ulanuğa küdık tuyndağanda äreket etu

[respondToSuspectedPoisoning.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/firstAidAndImmediateResponse/medicalEmergencies/respondToSuspectedPoisoning.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify possible toxic exposures, prevent further exposure without risking the helper and seek poison-service or emergency guidance; do not induce vomiting or improvise remedies. Opioid-specific response is addressed separately.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öz betınşe em jasaudyñ ornyna ulanu ortalyğynyñ ne jedel kömektıñ keñesın al.

### Densaulyq sauattylyğy jäne kütım

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal health decisions rely on interpreting bodily changes, credible evidence, and the division of responsibility between self-care and professional services. This domain concerns informed choices and access to care rather than the biological mechanisms of disease.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Densaulyq özgerısterın baiqaudy, senımdı aqparat qoldanudy jäne tiıstı kömek aludy üiren.

#### Densaulyq jäne täuekelder

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Health depends on interacting physical, psychological, social, and environmental conditions. Risk factors affect probability rather than determining an individual's diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärtürlı jağdailar men tañdaular densaulyq täuekelıne qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Densaulyqqa qatysty täuekeldı bağalau

[assessHealthRelatedRisk.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/assessHealthRelatedRisk.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Evaluate the likelihood and potential consequences of longer-term health outcomes arising from exposures, behaviours or protective measures, accounting for uncertainty without converting population-level estimates into diagnoses.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Densaulyq täuekelınıñ yqtimaldyğy men mümkın saldaryn bağala.

##### Aldyn alu şaralaryn tañdau

[choosePreventiveHealthMeasures.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/choosePreventiveHealthMeasures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Match health risks to evidence-based prevention such as vaccination, screening advice or protective daily habits, distinguishing the prevention of illness from first aid, clinical treatment and general accident avoidance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senımdı meditsinalyq derekter negızınde tiıstı aldyn alu şaralaryn tañda.

##### Densaulyqqa äser etetın faktorlardy anyqtau

[identifyFactorsAffectingHealth.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/identifyFactorsAffectingHealth.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect habits, exposures, living conditions, heredity, and access to services with health outcomes while avoiding simplistic one-cause explanations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ädetter men orta basqa faktorlarmen bırge densaulyqqa qalai äser etetının bıl.

##### Negızgı densaulyq ölşemderın tüsındıru

[interpretBasicHealthMeasurements.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/interpretBasicHealthMeasurements.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate observations such as temperature, pulse, or blood pressure to measurement conditions and reference context without making a diagnosis from one reading.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Negızgı densaulyq körsetkışterın tüsın, bıraq bır nätijenı diagnoz dep sanama.

##### Densaulyq jağdaiynyñ özgerısın tanu

[recognizeChangesInHealthStatus.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthAndRisk/recognizeChangesInHealthStatus.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish a usual bodily variation from a new or worsening change that deserves monitoring or advice, without treating a single symptom as a definitive diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Denedegı jaña özgerıske qaşan nazar audaru nemese mamannan keñes alu keregın tany.

#### Densaulyq aqparaty jäne därıler

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Claims about prevention and treatment should be evaluated against trustworthy evidence, and medicines require label-aware, safe handling; clinical observations and basic measurements are classified in Health and Risk.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Meditsinalyq keñesterdı bağalaudy jäne därılerdı qauıpsız qoldanudy üiren.

##### Densaulyq aqparaty közderın bağalau

[evaluateHealthInformationSources.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/evaluateHealthInformationSources.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess provenance, professional consensus, supporting evidence, conflicts of interest, and publication context rather than relying on popularity or testimonials.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Densaulyq keñesı senımdı, dälelge negızdelgen közden şyqqanyn tekser.

##### Jañylystyratyn densaulyq mälımdemelerın tanu

[recognizeMisleadingHealthClaims.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/recognizeMisleadingHealthClaims.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify miracle-cure promises, unsupported causal claims, and advertising disguised as medical advice, including claims about supplements.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dälelsız ğajaiyp em men aldamşy meditsinalyq jarnamany tany.

##### Därılerdı qauıpsız qoldanu

[useMedicinesSafely.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/healthInformationAndMedicines/useMedicinesSafely.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respect intended use, dosing instructions, contraindications, storage, expiry, and professional guidance; avoid sharing prescription medicine or guessing a dose.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Därı nūsqaulyğyn ūstan; därını bölıspe jäne dozasyn boljama.

#### Meditsinalyq kömekke jügınu

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Seeking care effectively includes choosing an appropriate service, describing a concern, understanding an agreed plan, and knowing when assistance is urgent.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Meditsinalyq kömek alyp, mamandarmen yntymaqtasudy üiren.

##### Tiıstı meditsinalyq kömek deñgeiın tañdau

[chooseAnAppropriateLevelOfHealthcare.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/chooseAnAppropriateLevelOfHealthcare.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routine consultation, timely professional assessment, and urgent emergency response by the nature and progression of symptoms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qai kezde josparly qabyldau, qai kezde şūğyl kömek qajet ekenın tany.

##### Meditsina mamanyna belgılerdı tüsındıru

[communicateSymptomsToAClinician.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/communicateSymptomsToAClinician.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Convey onset, duration, relevant changes, treatments already taken, and questions without substituting an assumed diagnosis for observations.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Därıgerge belgılerdı jäne olardyñ qaşan bastalğanyn anyq ait.

##### Sanaly meditsinalyq şeşımderge qatysu

[participateInInformedHealthcareDecisions.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/participateInInformedHealthcareDecisions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the roles of understandable information, consent, alternatives, privacy, and the right to ask questions in clinical encounters.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Emdelu kezındegı kelısım, qūpiialylyq jäne sūraq qoiu qūqyğyn bıl.

##### Emdeu josparyn tüsınu

[understandACarePlan.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/healthLiteracyAndCare/usingHealthcare/understandACarePlan.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Interpret the purpose, timing, follow-up, and precautions of a clinician's instructions and clarify uncertainty before acting.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kelısılgen emdeu josparynyñ maqsatyn, kestesın jäne saqtyq şaralaryn tüsın.

### Gigiena jäne infektsiialardyñ aldyn alu

Groups: 3 · Skills: 12

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Disease prevention includes reducing contact with infectious agents and maintaining sanitary conditions. This domain concerns personal and environmental prevention, not microbiological taxonomy or clinical infection treatment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Gigiena men qauıpsız orta infektsiiany qalai azaitatynyn zertte.

#### Jeke gigiena

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Effective routines reflect how contamination spreads between hands, body surfaces, shared objects, and everyday environments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qol men kündelıktı zattardyñ lastanuyn azaitatyn ädetter qalyptastyr.

##### Dene gigienasy

[bodyHygiene.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/bodyHygiene.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select suitable cleaning and personal-care routines for skin, hair, and intimate areas without assuming excessive washing is beneficial.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Terı men denege kütım jasaudyñ qolaily ädetterın tañda.

##### Qol gigienasy

[handHygiene.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/handHygiene.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use washing or an appropriate hand sanitizer at meaningful moments, paying attention to coverage and the circumstances in which soap and water are needed.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qoldy qaşan jäne qalai tiımdı juu keregın bıl.

##### Jeke zattar gigienasy

[hygieneOfPersonalItems.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/hygieneOfPersonalItems.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce contamination from shared towels, grooming tools, and reusable items through appropriate individual use and cleaning.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jeke zattardy taza ūsta jäne infektsiia taratatyn zattardy bölıspe.

##### Auyz quysynyñ gigienasy

[oralHygiene.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/personalHygiene/oralHygiene.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maintain teeth and gums through suitable brushing, interdental care, and preventive dental visits while recognizing that pain or bleeding may require assessment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tıs pen qyzyl iektı qorğaityn kündelıktı ädetterdı üiren.

#### Sanitarlyq orta

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Water, indoor air, surfaces, and sanitation infrastructure influence exposure and should be managed according to actual contamination pathways.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıpsız su, aua men better infektsiia qaupıne qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Tazalau jäne dezinfektsiia

[cleaningAndDisinfection.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/cleaningAndDisinfection.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routine removal of dirt from targeted disinfection and avoid unsafe mixing or misuse of cleaning chemicals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kündelıktı tazalau men maqsatty dezinfektsiiany ajyrat, himiialyq zattardy dūrys qoldan.

##### Bölme auasy jäne jeldetu

[indoorAirAndVentilation.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/indoorAirAndVentilation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify circumstances in which fresh-air exchange and source control reduce airborne exposure, while accounting for outdoor hazards.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Syrttağy qauıpterdı eskerıp, bölmenı jeldetu arqyly äserdı azait.

##### Qauıpsız auyzsu

[safeDrinkingWater.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/sanitaryEnvironments/safeDrinkingWater.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish potable from potentially contaminated supplies and recognize when verified treatment or an alternative source is required.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Su közı qaşan ışuge qauıptı boluy mümkın ekenın tany.

#### Jūğu joldary jäne qorğanu

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Infectious hazards can spread through different routes and require measures suited to the agent and environment, not one universal precaution.

**User-friendly description (kk):** İnfektsiia qalai jūğatynyn jäne är jolğa laiyq saqtyq şaralaryn bıl.

##### İnfektsiia jūğu joldaryn tanu

[recognizeInfectionTransmissionRoutes.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/recognizeInfectionTransmissionRoutes.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish respiratory, contact, foodborne, bloodborne, and vector-related exposure when considering prevention.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Janasu, tynys alu, tağam jäne özge joldarmen jūğudy tany.

##### Tynys alu gigienasy

[respiratoryHygiene.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/respiratoryHygiene.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Reduce exposure when coughing, sneezing, or experiencing respiratory symptoms using appropriate etiquette, ventilation, and context-specific precautions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jötel ädebın, jeldetudı jäne auyrğanda saqtyq şaralaryn ūstan.

##### Jūqpaly auru belgılerıne äreket etu

[respondToSignsOfInfectiousIllness.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/respondToSignsOfInfectiousIllness.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Decide when to rest, reduce exposure to others, monitor worsening symptoms, and seek professional advice rather than relying solely on home care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Auyrğanda qaşan bailanystardy azaitu nemese därıgerge jügınu keregın tany.

##### Qan jäne dene sūiyqtyqtarymen qauıpsız bailanys

[safeContactWithBloodAndBodyFluids.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/safeContactWithBloodAndBodyFluids.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Avoid direct unprotected exposure and understand when barriers, handwashing, and professional assistance are necessary.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qan men dene sūiyqtyqtarymen jūmys ıstegende qorğanu nege mañyzdy ekenın tüsın.

##### Vaktsinatsiia turaly sauattylyq

[vaccinationLiteracy.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/hygieneAndInfectionPrevention/transmissionAndProtection/vaccinationLiteracy.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish how immunization reduces specified disease risks from claims of absolute protection and recognize the role of recommended schedules.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ekpenıñ neden qorğaitynyn jäne qorğau şekterın tüsın.

### Psihikalyq saulyq pen qoldau

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Health protection includes noticing psychological strain, choosing supportive coping strategies, and connecting people with qualified help. The psychological mechanisms of emotion and cognition belong principally to Psychology.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Emotsiialyq küizelıstı baiqaudy, qoldau ızdeudı jäne dağdarysta qauıpsız äreket etudı üiren.

#### Kündelıktı qiyndyqtardy eñseru jäne kömek

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Helpful responses can involve self-care, support networks, appropriate boundaries, and referral rather than demanding that a person solve a crisis alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kündelıktı qiyndyqty eñseru joldary men laiyqty kömek közderın bıl.

##### Sozylmaly şamadan tys jüktemenıñ aldyn alu

[preventChronicOverload.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/preventChronicOverload.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice sustained imbalance between demands and recovery and identify feasible changes or sources of support.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūzaq jükteme qaşan demalysty ne naqty özgerıstı talap etetının baiqa.

##### Psihikalyq densaulyqqa qoldau ızdeu

[seekMentalHealthSupport.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/seekMentalHealthSupport.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify trusted people, professional services, and ways of communicating a concern, including when ordinary support is insufficient.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Senımdı adamğa ne bılıktı psihikalyq densaulyq qyzmetıne qalai jügınuge bolatynyn bıl.

##### Emotsiialyq küizelıstegı adamğa qoldau körsetu

[supportSomeoneExperiencingDistress.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/supportSomeoneExperiencingDistress.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Listen without judgment, respect privacy, avoid diagnosing, and help the person reach appropriate assistance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdy tyñdap, tiıstı kömek tabuyna järdemdes.

##### Qauıpsız eñseru täsılderın qoldanu

[useSafeCopingStrategies.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/everydayCopingAndAssistance/useSafeCopingStrategies.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select proportionate methods such as grounding, rest, movement, and social connection without presenting them as substitutes for necessary care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kündelıktı küizelıstı eñserudıñ oryndy ärı qauıpsız joldaryn tañda.

#### Psihikalyq densaulyq dağdarystary

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Immediate safety and connection to competent support take priority over attempting therapy or managing a potentially dangerous situation alone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şūğyl psihologiialyq qauıp töngende nege dereu bılıktı kömek qajet ekenın tüsın.

##### Alğaşqy psihologiialyq kömek körsetu

[providePsychologicalFirstAid.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/providePsychologicalFirstAid.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Offer calm, practical, non-intrusive support, immediate needs assessment, and connection with services without forcing disclosure of traumatic experiences.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Adamdy jaraqattağan oqiğasyn baiandauğa mäjbürlemei, sabyrly ärı praktikalyq kömek ūsyn.

##### Jedel psihologiialyq dağdarysty tanu

[recognizeAnAcutePsychologicalCrisis.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/recognizeAnAcutePsychologicalCrisis.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify immediate danger, severe disorientation, or expressed intent to self-harm as circumstances requiring prompt adult or professional help.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Eresek adam ne mamannyñ şūğyl kömegı qajet jağdailardy tany.

##### Özıne ziian keltıru nemese suitsid qaupıne äreket etu

[respondToSelfHarmOrSuicideRisk.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/mentalHealthCrises/respondToSelfHarmOrSuicideRisk.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize safety, timely emergency or crisis-service involvement, and staying within one's competence without secrecy promises.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Özıne ziian keltıru qaupınde nege tez arada qauıpsızdık qoldauy qajet ekenın tüsın.

#### Psihologiialyq jüktemenı tanu

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distress varies in intensity and duration; a sign can indicate a need for support without establishing a psychiatric diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Psihologiialyq qoldau qajet boluy mümkın ekenın bıldıretın özgerısterdı baiqa.

##### Ziiandy eñseru dağdylaryn tanu

[recognizeHarmfulCopingPatterns.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/recognizeHarmfulCopingPatterns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish restorative actions from strategies that may intensify distress or introduce additional risks.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaña mäseleler tudyruy mümkın qiyndyqty eñseru ädetterın baiqa.

##### Küizelıs belgılerın tanu

[recognizeSignsOfStress.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/recognizeSignsOfStress.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect changes in sleep, concentration, mood, behaviour, or bodily tension with potential overload while considering other causes.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küizelıstıñ jiı kezdesetın belgılerın tanyp, basqa yqtimal sebepterdı de esker.

##### Psihikalyq densaulyqtyñ naşarlau belgılerın tanu

[recognizeWarningSignsOfWorseningMentalHealth.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/mentalWellBeingAndSupport/recognizingStrain/recognizeWarningSignsOfWorseningMentalHealth.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify persistent impairment, escalating distress, or loss of usual functioning as reasons to seek suitable support.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūzaqqa sozylğan ne küşeigen, qosymşa qoldau qajet etetın qiyndyqtardy baiqa.

### Qozğalys, ūiqy jäne kündelıktı ädetter

Groups: 3 · Skills: 10

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical functioning benefits from feasible movement, adequate recovery, and adjustments to daily environments. This domain concerns practical health habits, not the physiology of exercise as a separate science.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qozğalysqa, qalpyna keluge jäne jaily kündelıktı tırlıkke paidaly tūraqty ädetterdı zertte.

#### Ergonomika jäne sezım müşelerın qorğau

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Workspaces and devices can be adapted to reduce strain, fatigue, and exposure rather than enforcing a single rigid body position.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene men sezım müşelerıne tüsetın jüktemenı azaitu üşın jūmys ornyn jäne qūrylğylardy beiımdeudı üiren.

##### Ergonomikalyq jūmys ornyn beiımdeu

[adaptAnErgonomicWorkspace.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/adaptAnErgonomicWorkspace.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Adjust screen, seat, reach, lighting, and variation of posture to a person's task and physical needs.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jūmys ornyn zatqa oñai qol jetkızuge, jaryqqa jäne dene qalpyn özgertuge beiımde.

##### Köz şarşauyn azaitu

[manageVisualStrain.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/manageVisualStrain.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use suitable lighting, viewing distance, breaks, and symptom awareness during sustained near or screen work.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūzaq oqyğanda nemese ekranmen jūmys ıstegende köz şarşauyn azait.

##### Estudı şudan qorğau

[protectHearingFromNoise.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/ergonomicsAndSensoryCare/protectHearingFromNoise.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate loudness and exposure time to hearing risk, including personal listening devices and noisy environments.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dybys deñgeiı men tyñdau ūzaqtyğynyñ ekeuı de estu qauıpsızdıgıne nege äser etetının tüsın.

#### Dene belsendılıgı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Activity can vary by intensity, form, and personal ability; protective choices include gradual progression and responding to warning signals.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öz mümkındıgıñdı eskerıp, belsendı qaludy üiren.

##### Tūraqty dene belsendılıgın josparlau

[planRegularPhysicalActivity.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/planRegularPhysicalActivity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Combine suitable types and amounts of movement with individual capacity and opportunities, rather than relying on one sport or a universal target.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qajettılıgıñ men jağdaiyña sai qoljetımdı qozğalysty josparla.

##### Dene jüktemesıne daiyndalu

[prepareForPhysicalExertion.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/prepareForPhysicalExertion.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use context-appropriate warm-up, equipment, environment checks, and gradual increases in demand.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene jüktemesıne deiın jabdyq pen ainalany tekser.

##### Jattyğuğa bailanysty jaraqattardyñ aldyn alu

[preventExerciseRelatedInjury.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/preventExerciseRelatedInjury.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Adjust technique, load, recovery, and protective measures to the activity without assuming injury is unavoidable.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jattyğuda aldyn aluğa bolatyn jaraqattar qaupın azaitudy üiren.

##### Belsendılık kezındegı qauıptı belgılerdı tanu

[recognizeWarningSignsDuringActivity.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/physicalActivity/recognizeWarningSignsDuringActivity.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish ordinary exertion from concerning symptoms or conditions requiring stopping, assistance, or medical assessment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ärekettı toqtatu keregın bıldıretın belgılerdı tany.

#### Ūiqy jäne qalpyna kelu

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Sleep quality is affected by timing, environment, individual needs, and habits; persistent difficulty may warrant professional attention.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūiqy men tūraqty demalys kündelıktı tırlıkke qalai äser etetının zertte.

##### Ūiqydağy alañdatarlyq özgerısterdı tanu

[recognizeProblematicSleepPatterns.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/recognizeProblematicSleepPatterns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice persistent disruption or dangerous sleepiness and distinguish a need for evaluation from an occasional poor night.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūzaqqa sozylğan ūiqy mäselesıne qaşan maman kömegı qajet ekenın bıl.

##### Salauatty ūiqy ädetterın qalyptastyru

[supportHealthySleepRoutines.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/supportHealthySleepRoutines.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify modifiable factors such as light, noise, stimulants, and schedule regularity that can affect sleep.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaqsy ūiyqtau üşın ädetterıñ men ortañdy beiımde.

##### Ūiqy qajettılıkterın tüsınu

[understandSleepNeeds.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/movementSleepAndEverydayRoutines/sleepAndRecovery/understandSleepNeeds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sufficient sleep and regular timing to functioning while accounting for differences across life stages and circumstances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ūiqy qajettılıgı jas pen jağdaiğa qarai qalai özgeretının bıl.

### Tamaqtanu jäne azyq-tülık qauıpsızdıgı

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Eating and drinking support health through nutrients, adequate intake, and safe preparation. Nutritional choices and microbial or chemical food hazards are distinct competencies, even though the same meal can involve both.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tamaqtanu men tağamdy qauıpsız öñdeu densaulyqqa qalai kömektesetının bıl.

#### Tağam tañdau jäne aqparat

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Marketing, accessibility, food labels, allergies, and personal circumstances shape real-life nutritional decisions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağam tañdağanda zattañba men senımdı derekterdı qoldanudy üiren.

##### Tağamdy dietalyq qajettılıkterge sai tañdau

[adaptFoodChoicesToDietaryNeeds.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/adaptFoodChoicesToDietaryNeeds.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select suitable alternatives for medical, nutritional, ethical or cultural dietary requirements, distinguishing individual preference from a potentially dangerous allergen exposure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağam tañdauyñdy naqty dietalyq qajet pen talğamğa sai özgert.

##### Tağam zattañbalaryn oqu

[interpretFoodLabels.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/interpretFoodLabels.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use ingredient lists, nutritional information, serving quantities, and date markings without treating a marketing slogan as evidence.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūramyn, portsiia mölşerın jäne tağamdyq qūndylyğyn oqy.

##### Tağam allergiiasy qauıpterın basqaru

[manageFoodAllergyRisks.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/manageFoodAllergyRisks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify allergens and cross-contact warnings, verify ingredients, take appropriate avoidance precautions and understand when an allergic reaction requires urgent care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Allergenderdı tany jäne ingredientterdıñ qauıptı özara janasuynan saqtan.

##### Tamaqtanu turaly jalğan aqparatty tanu

[recognizeDietaryMisinformation.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodChoicesAndInformation/recognizeDietaryMisinformation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish evidence-based nutritional advice from detox claims, extreme restrictions, and unsupported promises of rapid results.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dieta, detoks jäne jyldam nätije turaly dälelsız uädelerdı tany.

#### Tağam arqyly taralatyn qauıpter

Skills: 5

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food safety depends on separation, temperature, handling, and storage; appearance or smell alone cannot always establish whether food is safe.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağamdy daiyndau jäne saqtau aurudyñ aldyn aluğa qalai kömektesetının bıl.

##### Tağam daiyndağanda tazalyq saqtau

[maintainHygieneDuringFoodPreparation.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/maintainHygieneDuringFoodPreparation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Maintain clean hands, utensils and work surfaces while preparing meals, limiting microbial contamination without subsuming the distinct task of keeping raw foods separate from ready-to-eat foods.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tamaq daiyndağanda qolyñ men asüi betterın taza ūsta.

##### Şikı jäne daiyn tağamnyñ aiqas lastanuyn boldyrmau

[preventRawToReadyFoodCrossContamination.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/preventRawToReadyFoodCrossContamination.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Keep raw animal products and their juices from contaminating ready-to-eat food through separate equipment, storage and handling; this concerns foodborne pathogens rather than allergen cross-contact.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şikı januar tektı önımderdı daiyn tağamnan bölek ūsta.

##### Tağam qauıpsızdıgıne qaterdı tanu

[recognizeUnsafeFoodSituations.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/recognizeUnsafeFoodSituations.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify spoilage, damaged packaging, unsafe water, and uncertain storage histories while understanding that some hazards are invisible.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağam qalypty körınse de, qauıpsızdık qaterlerın baiqap üiren.

##### Qauıpsız pısıru jäne qaita jylytu

[safeCookingAndReheating.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/safeCookingAndReheating.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate sufficient heating to reducing specified foodborne hazards rather than relying only on colour or texture.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tağamdy dūrys pısıru jäne qaita jylytu nege mañyzdy ekenın tüsın.

##### Tağamdy qauıpsız saqtau

[safeFoodStorage.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/foodborneHazards/safeFoodStorage.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select appropriate storage conditions and time limits, distinguishing shelf-stable from perishable foods.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tez būzylatyn önımderdı tiıstı jağdaida saqta.

#### Tamaqtanu negızderı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Food supplies energy and essential nutrients; dietary adequacy depends on patterns over time rather than judging a single meal as healthy or unhealthy.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tamaqtanudy bır retkı asqa qarap emes, ūzaq merzımdı tamaq tañdau ädetterı boiynşa bağala.

##### Teñgerımdı tamaqtanu ülgılerı

[balancedDietaryPatterns.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/balancedDietaryPatterns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Consider variety, food groups, nutrient adequacy, and individual needs without assuming one fixed menu fits everyone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Öz qajettılıgıñe sai aluan türlı tamaqtanudy qalyptastyr.

##### Ağzanyñ su teñgerımı

[hydration.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/hydration.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize fluid needs and common signs of insufficient intake while accounting for activity, climate, and health circumstances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Belsendılık pen qorşağan orta su qajettılıgıne qalai äser etetının tüsın.

##### Tamaq energiiasynyñ teñgerımın tüsınu

[interpretDietaryEnergyBalance.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/interpretDietaryEnergyBalance.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate energy intake to expenditure and changing individual needs while distinguishing energy balance from dietary quality and avoiding unsupported conclusions about a person's health from body size.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qabyldanğan jäne jūmsalğan energiiany jalpy tamaq sapasynan ajyrat.

##### Qorektık zattardyñ rölın tüsınu

[understandTheRolesOfNutrients.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/nutritionAndFoodSafety/nutritionalFoundations/understandTheRolesOfNutrients.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relate macronutrients, vitamins, minerals and fibre to their major physiological roles and distinguish nutritional adequacy from the amount of food alone, without reproducing biochemical mechanisms.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qorektık zattar men talşyqtyñ ärtürlı qyzmetın tany.

### Jeke şekaralar jäne zorlyqtyñ aldyn alu

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Safety in relationships requires bodily autonomy, recognition of coercion, and effective routes to protection. Mechanisms of social influence are studied in Psychology; here the emphasis is on avoiding harm and obtaining help.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mäjbürleu men zorlyqty tanyp, öz qauıpsızdıgıñ men şekaralaryñdy qorğaudy üiren.

#### Dene derbestıgı jäne kelısım

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Personal space, privacy, and permission govern respectful contact; consent must not be inferred from silence, fear, or power imbalance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Rūqsat, jeke ömır jäne öz deneñe qatysty şeşım qabyldau qūqyğyn tüsın.

##### Bas tartu men şekaralardy jetkızu

[communicateRefusalAndLimits.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/communicateRefusalAndLimits.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** State a boundary or leave an unsafe interaction in a way that prioritizes personal safety over politeness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıptı janasudan bas tart nemese alysta; sypaiylyqtan būryn qauıpsızdıktı tañda.

##### Jeke şekaralardy tanu

[recognizePersonalBoundaries.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/recognizePersonalBoundaries.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish acceptable from unwanted contact and intrusion into personal space, possessions, or sensitive information.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Janasu nemese aqparat bölısu bıreudıñ jeke şekarasyn qaşan būzatynyn baiqa.

##### Jaramdy kelısımdı tanu

[recognizeValidConsent.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/bodilyAutonomyAndConsent/recognizeValidConsent.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish voluntary, informed, specific, and reversible permission from pressure or absence of resistance.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Şynaiy kelısım erıktı, aqparatqa negızdelgen jäne qaitaryp alynatyn boluy tiıs.

#### Qysym jäne aila-şarğy

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Coercion can use threats, secrecy, guilt, status, dependency, or urgency; a protective response need not persuade the aggressor.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mäjbürleu erkın tañdau ornyna kınä sezımın, qorqytudy ne qūpiiany qalai qoldanatynyn bıl.

##### Senımge kırıp aldau men qanaudy tanu

[recognizeGroomingAndExploitation.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/recognizeGroomingAndExploitation.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify boundary testing, forced secrecy, rewards, and escalating requests as possible patterns of exploitation without blaming the targeted person.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūpiia saqtaudy talap etu men üdei tüsken ötınışter qanaudyñ belgısı boluy mümkın.

##### Psihologiialyq qysymdy tanu

[recognizePsychologicalPressure.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/recognizePsychologicalPressure.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify demands reinforced by guilt, intimidation, isolation, or threatened consequences rather than genuine choice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qorqytu, oqşaulau ne jazamen ses körsetu arqyly qysym jasaudy tany.

##### Qauıptı qūrdastar qysymyna qarsy tūru

[resistUnsafePeerPressure.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/resistUnsafePeerPressure.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use refusal, disengagement, and supportive allies when a group promotes hazardous or humiliating behaviour.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūrdastardyñ ziiandy ötınışterınen qauıpsız bas tartu jolyn tap.

##### Teñ emes qarym-qatynasta şekara belgıleu

[setBoundariesInUnequalRelationships.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/pressureAndManipulation/setBoundariesInUnequalRelationships.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Account for authority, dependency, age, or financial power when judging whether a demand or apparent agreement is free.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Bilık ne täueldılık syrttai berılgen kelısımnıñ şynaiylyğyn qalai älsıretetının tüsın.

#### Zorlyq jäne qorğanu

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Violence can be physical, psychological, sexual, economic, or digital; protection and reporting should avoid exposing affected people to retaliation.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ziiandy mınez-qūlyqty tanyp, qorğanyş ızdeudı üiren.

##### Bullingtı tanu

[recognizeBullying.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/recognizeBullying.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify a pattern of harmful repeated conduct involving a power imbalance, distinguishing bullying from a mutual disagreement or an isolated conflict.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Küş teñsızdıgı bar qaitalanatyn qorlaudy qarapaiym janjaldan ajyrat.

##### Tūrmystyq jäne jynystyq zorlyqty tanu

[recognizeDomesticAndSexualViolence.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/recognizeDomesticAndSexualViolence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify controlling, threatening, non-consensual, or abusive behaviour, including harm by familiar or trusted people.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Baqylau, qorqytu jäne kelısımsız äreketter zorlyq ekenın tany.

##### Qudalaudy tanu

[recognizeHarassment.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/recognizeHarassment.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify intimidating, degrading, discriminatory or otherwise unwanted targeted conduct, which may be serious even without a repeated bullying pattern.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qaitalanbasa da ziian keltıruı mümkın qudalaudy baiqa.

##### Bullingke qauıpsız äreket etu

[respondSafelyToBullying.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/respondSafelyToBullying.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Prioritize disengagement, trusted assistance, and reporting channels over retaliation or direct confrontation with aggressors.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kek aludyñ ornyna qauıpsız kömek sūrap, habarlaudy tañda.

##### Zorlyqtan keiın qorğanyş ızdeu

[seekProtectionAfterViolence.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/seekProtectionAfterViolence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify safe contacts, support organizations, emergency services, and appropriate documentation without requiring disclosure to an unsafe person.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zorlyq körgennen keiın jügınuge bolatyn qauıpsız adamdar men qyzmetterdı tap.

##### Zorlyqtan zardap şekken adamğa qoldau körsetu

[supportAPersonAffectedByViolence.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/personalBoundariesAndViolencePrevention/violenceAndProtection/supportAPersonAffectedByViolence.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Respond without blame, respect the person's choices and immediate safety, and facilitate qualified support rather than investigating the incident.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kınälamai jäne qauıptı jeke tergeu jürgızbei qoldau körset.

### Jynystyq jäne reproduktivtık densaulyq

Groups: 2 · Skills: 7

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Practical knowledge about bodily development, sexual health, prevention, and access to services supports informed and safe choices. Anatomy and reproductive mechanisms are mainly Biology; moral evaluation is not substituted for factual health information.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Dene damuy, reproduktivtık densaulyq jäne qoljetımdı kömek turaly naqty derekterdı bıl.

#### Damu jäne dene kütımı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Changes through puberty differ in timing and expression; normal variation and symptoms needing assessment should not be conflated.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jynystyq jetılu kezındegı dene özgerısterı men dūrys kütımdı bıl.

##### Etekkır densaulyğyn kütu

[manageMenstrualHealth.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/manageMenstrualHealth.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Understand menstrual variation, choose appropriate hygiene and comfort measures, track relevant changes and recognize symptoms that merit clinical attention without shame or unsupported assumptions.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Etekkır kezınde tiıstı gigienany saqtap, alañdatarlyq belgılerdı baiqa.

##### Reproduktivtık densaulyq mäselelerın tanu

[recognizeReproductiveHealthConcerns.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/recognizeReproductiveHealthConcerns.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice pain, abnormal symptoms, or other changes that may require confidential professional consultation without self-diagnosis.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Mamannyñ qūpiia keñesı qajet boluy mümkın özgerısterdı baiqa.

##### Jynystyq jetılu özgerısterın tüsınu

[understandPubertalChanges.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/developmentAndBodilyCare/understandPubertalChanges.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish common physical changes and variations in timing from unsupported claims about a single correct developmental pattern.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jetıludıñ uaqyty men sipaty är adamda ärtürlı boluy qalypty ekenın tüsın.

#### Jynystyq jäne reproduktivtık densaulyq saqtau

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Risk reduction and access to care include prevention of sexually transmitted infections, contraception, pregnancy-related care and confidential advice. These are health-service competencies, not a prescribed set of personal choices.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Aldyn alu, jüktılık jäne jynystyq densaulyq boiynşa meditsinalyq kömek joldaryn bıl.

##### Jynystyq jolmen berıletın infektsiialardyñ aldyn alu

[preventSexuallyTransmittedInfections.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/preventSexuallyTransmittedInfections.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish routes of transmission and evidence-based protective methods, testing, and vaccination where relevant.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jynystyq jolmen jūğatyn infektsiialar qaupın azaitu joldaryn bıl.

##### Jynystyq densaulyq boiynşa qūpiia keñes alu

[seekConfidentialSexualHealthAdvice.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/seekConfidentialSexualHealthAdvice.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify appropriate services and questions about privacy, safeguarding, consent, and access to care.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Reproduktivtık densaulyq turaly qūpiia sūraqtarğa arnalğan tiıstı qyzmetterdı tap.

##### Kontratseptsiiany tüsınu

[understandContraception.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/understandContraception.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Compare major methods by intended function, limitations, access considerations, and need for appropriate professional advice.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kontratseptsiianyñ negızgı ädısterınıñ qyzmetı men şekteulerın salystyr.

##### Jüktılık kezındegı meditsinalyq kömektı tüsınu

[understandPregnancyRelatedHealthcare.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/sexualAndReproductiveHealth/sexualAndReproductiveHealthcare/understandPregnancyRelatedHealthcare.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify the roles of testing, timely medical assessment, antenatal care, and support services in different circumstances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Tekseruler men käsıbi jüktılık kütımınıñ rölın tüsın.

### Zattardy qoldanu jäne täueldılıktıñ aldyn alu

Groups: 2 · Skills: 8

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Tobacco, alcohol, drugs, and other dependence-forming patterns can affect health and safety. The focus is recognizing hazards, resisting coercion, and seeking care rather than pharmacological synthesis or moral judgment.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattar men täueldılıktıñ ziianyn tanyp, qaidan kömek tabudy bıl.

#### Aldyn alu jäne kömekke qol jetkızu

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/preventionAndAccessToHelp/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Dependence involves more than a single behaviour; early support and non-stigmatizing treatment pathways matter.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ziiandy qoldanudyñ aldyn alu men erte qoldau ızdeu joldaryn bıl.

##### Mınez-qūlyqtyq täueldılık qaupın tanu

[recognizeBehaviouralDependenceRisks.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/preventionAndAccessToHelp/recognizeBehaviouralDependenceRisks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify patterns of gambling or digital engagement that cause persistent harm without assuming ordinary enjoyment is addiction.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qūmar oiyndar ne tsifrlyq äreketter qaşan tūraqty ziian keltıretının baiqa.

##### Mäselelı qoldanu belgılerın tanu

[recognizeSignsOfProblematicUse.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/preventionAndAccessToHelp/recognizeSignsOfProblematicUse.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Notice loss of control, increasing harms, and neglected obligations as reasons for further assessment rather than a basis for labeling someone.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qoldanu qaşan küşeigen ziianğa nemese baqylaudan aiyryluğa äkeletının baiqa.

##### Ziiandy zattardy ūsynuğa äreket etu

[respondToOffersOfHarmfulSubstances.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/preventionAndAccessToHelp/respondToOffersOfHarmfulSubstances.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use refusal and exit strategies appropriate to pressure, power dynamics, and immediate safety.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Ziiandy zat ūsynylsa, qauıpsız bas tartyp, jağdaidan alystau joldaryn qoldan.

##### Zattarğa bailanysty mäselelerde kömek ızdeu

[seekHelpForSubstanceRelatedProblems.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/preventionAndAccessToHelp/seekHelpForSubstanceRelatedProblems.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify trusted people and health or addiction services, including urgent assistance for suspected poisoning or overdose.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattardan ziian kelgende qoldau ne şūğyl kömek qaşan qajet ekenın bıl.

#### Zattarğa bailanysty qauıpter

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/substanceRelatedRisks/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Effects depend on the substance, amount, context, interactions, and vulnerability; legal availability does not imply harmlessness.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Zattardyñ äserı men qaupı jağdaiğa qarai qalai özgeretının zertte.

##### Alkogolge bailanysty qauıpterdı tanu

[recognizeAlcoholRelatedRisks.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/substanceRelatedRisks/recognizeAlcoholRelatedRisks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify impaired judgment, coordination, poisoning risk, and longer-term health consequences associated with alcohol.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Alkogol qauıpsızdıkke, paiymğa jäne ūzaq merzımdı densaulyqqa qalai äser etetının tüsın.

##### Esırtkıge bailanysty qauıpterdı tanu

[recognizeDrugRelatedRisks.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/substanceRelatedRisks/recognizeDrugRelatedRisks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Distinguish unpredictable potency, impairment, overdose, and interactions without treating all substances as having identical effects.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qabılettıñ naşarlauy, artyq mölşer jäne zattar özara äserınıñ qauıpterın tany.

##### Därını dūrys qoldanbaudy tanu

[recognizeMedicineMisuse.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/substanceRelatedRisks/recognizeMedicineMisuse.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Identify hazardous use outside prescribed or labelled purposes, including sharing medication and mixing substances.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Därını basqalarğa beru nemese qate qoldanudyñ qauıptı joldaryn tany.

##### Temekı men nikotin qaupın tanu

[recognizeTobaccoAndNicotineRisks.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/substanceUseAndDependencePrevention/substanceRelatedRisks/recognizeTobaccoAndNicotineRisks.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Connect smoking, vaping, and other nicotine exposure with dependence and health harm, including second-hand exposure.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Temekı şegu, veip jäne nikotin äserınıñ qaupın tüsın.

### Kölık, su jäne dala qauıpsızdıgı

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Movement outside controlled environments combines traffic rules, environmental conditions, and limited opportunities for immediate rescue. This domain addresses safe decisions rather than vehicle engineering.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Saparda, jüzgende jäne dalada qauıpsız şeşım qabyldaudy üiren.

#### Jol jäne kölık qauıpsızdıgı

Skills: 4

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/roadAndTransportSafety/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Protection differs for pedestrians, riders, passengers, and drivers; visible signals and protective equipment do not remove every traffic risk.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jaiau jürgınşı, jolauşy jäne jürgızuşı üşın jol qauıpterınıñ aiyrmasyn bıl.

##### Velosiped jäne şağyn kölık qauıpsızdıgı

[cyclingAndMicromobilitySafety.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/roadAndTransportSafety/cyclingAndMicromobilitySafety.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Use protective equipment, safe positioning, visibility, and context-appropriate road rules for bicycles and similar devices.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Velosiped ne şağyn kölık mıngende qorğanys qūraldaryn qoldanyp, közge körınetın bol.

##### Jolauşy qauıpsızdıgı

[passengerSafety.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/roadAndTransportSafety/passengerSafety.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize the role of seat belts, appropriate child restraints, safe boarding, and behavior in moving vehicles.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Qauıpsızdık beldıkterı men balalar avtokreslolarynyñ qorğanys qyzmetın tüsın.

##### Jaiau jürgınşılerdıñ jol qauıpsızdıgı

[pedestrianRoadSafety.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/roadAndTransportSafety/pedestrianRoadSafety.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess crossings, visibility, traffic movement, signals, and distractions before entering a roadway.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kölık qozğalysyn, belgıler men körınudı baqylap, qauıpsız ötkeldı tañda.

##### Qauıpsız jürgızu şeşımderı

[safeDrivingDecisions.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/roadAndTransportSafety/safeDrivingDecisions.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Recognize how fatigue, impairment, speed, distraction, and environmental conditions affect driving risk and the duty not to drive unsafely.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Nazardyñ bölınuı, jyldamdyq jäne qabılettıñ tömendeuı jürgızudı nege qauıptı etetının tüsın.

#### Su qauıpsızdıgı

Skills: 3

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/waterSafety/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Drowning can occur quickly and silently; preventing entry into danger and using non-contact rescue options are distinct from trained water rescue.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Suğa batudyñ aldyn aludy jäne özgelerge qauıp töndırmei kömektesudı üiren.

##### Jüzu men şomylu qaupın bağalau

[assessSwimmingAndBathingHazards.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/waterSafety/assessSwimmingAndBathingHazards.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Assess water-specific conditions such as depth, currents, temperature, supervision, safe access and local warnings before entering; this applies general hazard judgment to an environment with distinct drowning risks.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Suğa tüser aldynda ağys, tereñdık pen baqylaudy bağala.

##### Suda qauıpke ūşyrağan adamğa kömektesu

[respondToAPersonInDangerInWater.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/waterSafety/respondToAPersonInDangerInWater.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Call for help and use safe reach-or-throw assistance where appropriate without putting an untrained rescuer into the water.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Kömek şaqyryp, suğa tüspei qauıpsız järdem berudı tañda.

##### Sudağy qauıpsızdık şaralaryn qoldanu

[useWaterSafetyMeasures.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/waterSafety/useWaterSafetyMeasures.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Select appropriate flotation, supervision, and activity limitations while recognizing the limits of swimming ability.

**User-friendly description (kk):** Jüzgende qalqymaly qūraldardy, baqylaudy jäne tiıstı saqtyq şaralaryn qoldan.

#### Aua raiy jäne tabiği qauıpter

Skills: 6

[index.ts](../../../content/health-safety/data/skills/transportWaterAndOutdoorSafety/weatherAndNatureHazards/index.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Outdoor risks vary with temperature, sunlight, storms, terrain, and wildlife; adaptation depends on current conditions and local alerts.

##### Jabaiy januarlar men ösımdıkter qauıpsızdıgı
